batch_note: “TCLC Box 1” is the name of the digitization folder these photographs came from. It is a project label, not a Kheel Center box number.
originals_note: Source PDFs are phone photographs with an Adobe Acrobat OCR layer. They are preserved unchanged offline; checksums below identify them exactly. Web images are derivatives rendered at native resolution and resized; some are rotated for viewing or have address labels covered.
sequence_note: Sequence pages 1–406 follow the order of the compiled file 'BOX 1 DOCS All.pdf'. The 13 source PDFs are consecutive slices of that sequence; pages 100, 200, and 300 each appear in two adjoining slices.
